posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hello @23f2001277

First Question

Option 3 - "email"[[:space: ]]*: [[:space: ]]*"([^"]*)"

Breakdown:

  • "email" → Matches the exact string "email" including double quotes.
  • [[:space: ]]* → Matches zero or more whitespace characters
  • : → Matches the literal colon
  • [[:space: ]]* → Matches optional spaces after the colon
  • "([^"]*)" → Captures everything inside double quotes after the colon:
  • ([^"]*) → Match zero or more characters excluding ". This captures the email or any quoted value.
  • [[:space: ]]+ → Matches at least one or more spaces

The third option is correct because * captures zero (no spaces) or more spaces.
The fourth option is incorrect because + will capture at least one space.

"email": "nulla.dignissim.maecenas@hotmail.org → Between “email” and : there is no space. So, + will not capture this pattern.

Second Question

cat server. log | grep "ERROR" | grep "WARNING" | wc -l → The grep "Error" command extracts all lines that contain the word “Error”. This output is then passed to grep "Warning", which further filters it to lines that also contain “Warning”. If no lines contain the word warning, the final output is empty. wc -l will return 0.

Warm Regards,
Swati Jain
